mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, content, msg_type, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_read = 0 AND (sender_type != #{receiverType} OR sender_id != #{receiverId})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_read = 0 AND (sender_type != #{receiverType} OR sender_id != #{receiverId})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_read = 1 AND (sender_type != #{viewerType} OR sender_id != #{viewerId})
